title: Button Group
description: The ButtonGroup component can be used to group related buttons.

blocks.text:
The buttons can be grouped by wrapping them with the `ButtonGroup` component.
They need to be immediate children.

blocks.name: BasicButtonGroup

blocks.text: All the standard button variants are supported.

blocks.name: VariantButtonGroup

blocks.text: The `size` and `color` props can be used to control the appearance of the button group.

blocks.name: GroupSizesColors

blocks.text: The button group can be displayed vertically using the `orientation` prop.

blocks.name: GroupOrientation

blocks.text: `ButtonGroup` can also be used to create a split button. The dropdown can change the button action (as in this example) or be used to immediately trigger a related action.

blocks.name: SplitButton

blocks.text: You can remove the elevation with the `disableElevation` prop.

blocks.name: DisableElevation

blocks.text: Use the `loading` prop from `Button` to set buttons in a loading state and disable interactions.

blocks.name: LoadingButtonGroup
